cards.ex: I know they're being aggressive, but fighting fire with fire will only make things worse.
cards.exUz: Men ularning tajovuzkorligini bilaman, lekin qasd olish vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga o'xshash usulda javob qaytarish, yomonlikka yomonlik bilan.

cards.ex: By threatening sanctions, they've raised the stakes in this international dispute.
cards.exUz: Sanksiyalar bilan tahdid qilib, ular bu xalqaro nizodagi xatarni oshirdilar.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada jiddiyroq yoki xavfliroq qilish.

cards.ex: The UN troops are there to keep the peace between the warring factions.
cards.exUz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkilotining qo'shinlari urushayotgan guruhlar o'rtasida tinchlikni saqlash uchun u yerda.
cards.uzDef: Tartibni saqlash, janjal yoki urushning oldini olish.

cards.ex: The conflict has become a war of attrition, with neither side making significant progress.
cards.exUz: Mojaro zaiflashtirish urushiga aylandi, hech qaysi tomon sezilarli yutuqlarga erishmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan urush, asta-sekin zaiflashtirishga qaratilgan.

cards.ex: Many hoped that the end of the Cold War would bring a substantial peace dividend.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik Sovuq Urush tugashi sezilarli tinchlik dividendini olib kelishiga umid qilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Urush tugagandan keyin olingan iqtisodiy foyda.

cards.ex: Without troops on the ground, it's difficult to assess the situation accurately.
cards.exUz: Yerda qo'shinlarsiz vaziyatni aniq baholash qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Urush zonasi kabi joylarda joylashgan askarlar.

cards.ex: It's important to remain neutral and not take sides in this dispute.
cards.exUz: Bu nizoda betaraf qolish va bir tomonni olmaslik muhim.

cards.ex: The region is a powder keg, with ethnic tensions threatening to ignite.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa porox bochkasi, etnik keskinliklar alangalanib ketish xavfi bor.

cards.ex: His pleas for peace fell on deaf ears, as both sides were determined to fight.
cards.exUz: Uning tinchlik iltimoslari hech kimga ta'sir qilmadi, chunki ikkala tomon ham jang qilishga qaror qilgan edi.

cards.ex: We need to nip this conflict in the bud before it escalates further.
cards.exUz: Biz bu mojaroo yanada kuchayib ketishidan oldin, boshlanishida to'xtatishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The leak of the documents forced the government's hand and made them announce the policy change.
cards.exUz: Hujjatlarning sizdirilishi hukumatni majburladi va ularni siyosatdagi o'zgarishlarni e'lon qilishga majbur qildi.

cards.ex: Some argue that a preemptive strike is necessary to prevent a greater threat.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, kattaroq xavfning oldini olish uchun oldindan zarba berish kerak.

cards.ex: The new missile treaty is aimed at preventing a dangerous arms race.
cards.exUz: Yangi raketa shartnomasi xavfli qurollanish poygasining oldini olishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida qurollanishda ustunlikka erishish uchun raqobat.

cards.ex: The country decided to declare war after the attack on its territory.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat o'z hududiga hujumdan keyin urush e'lon qilishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: Aid workers are struggling to reach people in the zone of conflict.
cards.exUz: Yordam xodimlari nizo hududidagi odamlarga yetib borish uchun kurashmoqdalar.

cards.ex: Winning the war requires winning the hearts and minds of the local population.
cards.exUz: Urushda g'alaba qozonish mahalliy aholining qalblari va onglarini zabt etishni talab qiladi.

cards.ex: The war-torn country is struggling to rebuild its infrastructure.
cards.exUz: Urush vayron qilgan mamlakat o'z infratuzilmasini qayta tiklash uchun kurashmoqda.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a war of nerves, with each side trying to intimidate the other.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar asablar urushiga aylandi, har bir tomon boshqasini qo'rqitishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ruhiy bosim va qo'rquv orqali g'alaba qozonishga qaratilgan mojaro.

cards.ex: The factory was put on a war footing to produce equipment for the troops.
cards.exUz: Zavod qo'shinlar uchun uskunalar ishlab chiqarish uchun urush holatiga keltirildi.

cards.ex: The military conducted a show of force to deter further aggression.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar keyingi tajovuzni to'xtatish uchun kuch namoyishini o'tkazdilar.

cards.ex: The diplomat is trying to broker a deal between the warring parties.
cards.exUz: Diplomat urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida bitim tuzishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tomonlar o'rtasida kelishuvga erishishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: The city was under siege for several weeks, with supplies running low.
cards.exUz: Shahar bir necha hafta davomida qamal ostida qoldi, ta'minot kamayib bormoqda.

cards.ex: He jumped the gun and announced the ceasefire before it was officially confirmed.
cards.exUz: U rasman tasdiqlanmasdan oldin o't ochishni to'xtatish haqida e'lon qilib shoshilib ketdi.

cards.ex: Winning the war is only half the battle; we also need to win the peace.
cards.exUz: Urushda g'alaba qozonish - jangning yarmi; biz tinchlikda ham g'alaba qozonishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Urushdan keyin tinchlikni saqlash va rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: It's time to bury the past and work towards a better future.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni unutib, yaxshiroq kelajak sari harakat qilish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xatolarni unutib, kelajakka e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: The two countries are observing an uneasy truce after years of fighting.
cards.exUz: Ikki mamlakat ko'p yillik janglardan so'ng noaniq sulhga rioya qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Beqaror va buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan sulh.

cards.ex: Let's clear the air and discuss our differences calmly.
cards.exUz: Keling, vaziyatni aniqlashtirib, farqlarimizni xotirjam muhokama qilaylik.

cards.ex: The government made a peace offering by releasing political prisoners.
cards.exUz: Hukumat siyosiy mahbuslarni ozod qilib, tinchlik taklifini berdi.

cards.ex: The signing of the treaty was a watershed moment in the history of the conflict.
cards.exUz: Shartnomaning imzolanishi mojaroning tarixidagi burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The two politicians have crossed swords on numerous occasions.
cards.exUz: Ikki siyosatchi ko'p marta bahslashgan.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan qattiq bahslashmoq yoki kurashmoq.
